notes.title: Update v0.1.1a
notes.notes:
🛠️ Patch Note v0.1.1a


A huge thank you to everyone who took the time to try out the Blockremental demo, dig tunnels, fight off waves of golems… and share their feedback! Your comments have been incredibly helpful in refining the gameplay, squashing bugs, and improving the overall experience.

This first patch is a solid one: we’ve added content, rebalanced systems, optimized performance, improved the interface… and even tweaked the lighting, because seeing clearly while digging matters.

One big swing of the pickaxe later, and here are the changes!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"]
📦 Freshly Mined Additions
Wooden Construction Cube  
Now available from Layer 1. Smells like fresh forest!

Cube Exchange System  
Trade in your old blocks for shiny new ones!

Guide Improvements  
Info bubbles now appear right before your very eyes.

Tooltips Added  
Hover over a craft with your mouse to learn more.

New Blocks: Concrete and Steel  
For bases that look as tough as they are.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"] 
🔧 Performance and Polish
FSR / Sharpen / FrameGen  
If you know what this means, great. If not: more FPS for everyone!

GameThread Optimization  
We mopped up performance issues like pros.

Improved Accessibility  
Mouse axis inversion, visible cursor, color options: everything to ensure everyone plays in comfort.

Unlockable Layer Cap Raised to 16  
Dig deeper than before (previously capped at 10).

Anti-Clipping System  
No more falling into the void like a cursed pixel. You’ll now be teleported to a safe zone automatically!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"] 
⚔️ Balancing (or at least an attempt...)
Defense Machines  
Damage values adjusted. Yes, again.

Breaker Machines  
Same deal. Still refining things with a chisel.

Progression & Recipes  
Major overhaul: core gameplay reviewed from the ground up. Your feedback is welcome!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"]   
🖥️ Interface & HUD
Redesigned HUD  
More visible slots, clearer selection, and an easier-to-read warning bar for incoming golem waves.

Improved 7x7 Platform  
Now includes colored indicators for better clarity at a glance.

Reward Interface Updated  
Clearer than ever: now you’ll know exactly what you’re gaining (or missing).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"] 
🧟 Golems & Waves
Improved AI  
Golem movement and speed have been slightly reduced for better pacing.

New Golem Waves  
The first wave now starts at Layer 4. The deeper you go, the tougher it gets: more health, speed, and damage.

Enhanced Conductivity  
All iron and copper blocks are now conductive. Ugly cables are out, stylish and functional builds are in. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"]  
🔦 Lighting & Weapons
Torches  
Lighting has been adjusted for better ambience.

MegaLamp  
Lights up the area like it's daytime.

WirelessLamp  
Increased range and brightness.

New Weapons:

IronAxe – Fast golem-slicing action, perfect for late-game.

Iron Mass – Smashes through EVERYTHING in its path. Yes, EVERYTHING. 💥

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"]   
🎵 Sound & Atmosphere
Music, SFX, ambient sounds  
Now deeper, richer, and more immersive. We added a little oil to your ears.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"]

That’s it for this first chunky patch. Keep digging, keep testing, keep smashing things—and please keep sharing your feedback! 

We’ll keep coding while you keep clobbering golems.
